metadata.description: Maria Chu is seeking an entry-level software engineer position with Boeing. She has strong written communication skills and attention to detail from her background in journalism and communications work. Her experience includes leading PR campaigns, restructuring internal systems, and designing social media campaigns. She also has experience as a court reporter with high accuracy rates and implementing accessibility programs.
